class.name: NetwWebRTCSignaler
class.brief_description: Extend it to exchange WebRTC offers, answers and ICE candidates through your own signaling server.

method.name: _close
method.description: Closes the connection to the signaling server. Called when the session closes.

method.name: _local_signaler_id
method.description: Returns this peer's address on the signaling server. Empty by default.

method.name: _on_session_connected
method.description: Called when the WebRTC connection to [param peer_id] is open. Override it to disconnect from the signaling server early.

method.name: _open
method.description: Connects to the signaling server for [param room_id] as [param local_peer_id]. The host is always [code]1[/code], and gets an empty [param room_id] when the signaler should create one and return it from [method _room_id]. Returning an error fails the connection.

method.name: _poll
method.description: Called every frame. Poll the signaling connection here.

method.name: _room_id
method.description: Returns the room opened by [method _open]. Players share it to join, so keep it readable.

method.name: _send
method.description: Sends [param payload] to [param to_peer_id]. [param to_address] is that peer's signaling address, or empty when unknown, in which case send it to the room. [param payload] has the shape shown in [method receive].

method.name: receive
method.description: Passes an offer, answer or candidate from [param from_peer] to the session. Pass each message once. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴offer / answer ┃ ┠╴type String "offer" or "answer" ┃ ┠╴sdp String the session description ┃ ┠╴candidates Array[Dictionary] the candidates, shaped as below ┃ ┖╴is_local bool true when both peers are in one process ┖╴candidate ┠╴type String "candidate" ┠╴candidate String the ICE candidate line ┠╴sdpMid String the media stream this candidate belongs to ┖╴sdpMLineIndex int the media line index this candidate belongs to [/codeblock]

method.name: report_lost
method.description: Call it when the signaling connection was open and was lost.

method.name: report_ready
method.description: Call it when the signaling connection is open. Calling it again is fine.

method.name: report_unreachable
method.description: Call it when the signaling connection could not be opened.
